findings.summary: Direct-path detector verdicts 2026-09-27 (after plan-v2 Phase 1.1 + 1.5): 4/4 AI reels caught (7/8 overall), 2/3 AI images caught, human post AUTHENTIC_HUMAN. Caveat: reel-03's pass rides on caption provenance (higgsfield -> metadata 75), not pixel forensics (pwtf 12, p05 0.67-0.71).
findings.web_vs_direct: rinse-web /api/scan (authed session -> /predict/image/deep + /predict/video/deep) returned byte-identical verdicts to direct detector calls on every asset (score + tier).
findings.ig-human-post-01: PASS at 12 AUTHENTIC_HUMAN HIGH since the yt-dlp cookie fallback; no longer login-walled.
detection_gaps: web-ai-italian-brainrot-poster: dense 15-character collage (1558 colors, edge 0.215, sat 0.526) matches no render signature - needs the Phase 4a collage signature.
ig-ai-reel-03: full-scene temporally self-consistent generation - pwtf 12 (p05 0.67-0.71), no pixel layer votes; caught only via caption provenance. Needs Phase 2a face/full-scene evidence.
CNNSpot neural layer reads ~0% on stylized/toon renders (trained on photorealistic content); muted-band + pf_strong structural floor covers images, nothing equivalent yet for full-scene video.
Human-reel corpus is 1 sample (ig-human-post-01); Phase 0 asks for 8-10 real reels before trusting any further threshold movement.
findings.env_notes: DetectZoo (cnnspot) installed in .venv 2026-09-27; without it the neural layer is inactive and every verdict is spatial-only.

phase1_2026_09_27.1_1_pwtf_contradiction_guard: ac1>0.70 structured-residual penalty no longer applies when coherence floor is collapsed (p05<0.20) - forensics/pwtf.py. reel-01 54 -> 62 -> 66 SUSPICIOUS.
phase1_2026_09_27.1_5_spatial_per_window: Top-2 subset: temporal pass on every window first, spatial layers on window 0 + strongest-pwtf window (server.py _analyze_video_frames). C2PA aggregates by claim decisiveness (AI 99 > camera 3 > EXIF 25 > none); max for detector layers; window_details records spatial_layers_run. No latency regression (reels 9-14s).
phase1_2026_09_27.verification: Full-suite regression 7/8 after the change; 6/8 before.
still_open: Phase 0 real-reel corpus expansion (currently 1 human reel)

image_caption_2026_09_27.change: Image paths now scan page-declared provenance context: source_caption (strong, 75 -> voter escalation), alt_text (strong like a caption), page_title/page_url/page_context (context only - weak votes, never a synthetic-band verdict alone), wired through /predict/image/deep and /fast with a context-sensitive cache-key suffix; the extension (content.js/background.js) sends alt/caption/page context with every image scan and keeps it on the byte-relay fallback; proxy image URLs decode base64url source payloads for filename hints.
image_caption_2026_09_27.guards: In-file AI metadata suppresses label scoring (no double counting); the camera-EXIF anti-AI vote is decided after label scans so a page-declared AI label is not masked by an early return; page context can never produce a synthetic-band verdict on its own; labels are reported with distinct alt_text/page_context marker prefixes.
image_caption_2026_09_27.verification: Probe behavior matrix (11 checks incl. suppression + EXIF unmasking + proxy decode); e2e: real flower_macro.jpg 62 UNCERTAIN -> 66 SUSPICIOUS when caption or alt names a generator, baseline unchanged without context; full regression suite unchanged at 7/8.
image_caption_2026_09_27.known_limit: Context is client-supplied and spoofable: it is provenance evidence, not pixel evidence - capped at metadata 75 (fused 66-70 band), and the reason text always labels it a provenance claim.

phase4a_collage_2026_09_27.change: Dense-collage signature upgraded with tile-uniformity structure (_collage_tile_stats, 4x4 grid): edge-density CV <= 0.30 + emptiest tile >= 280 quantized colors + mean tile edge >= 0.15 lifts the boost from 60 to 70 when the base gate (sat >= 0.50 + edge >= 0.17 + colors >= 1100) also holds; pf_strong floor then moves the fused verdict to 70 SUSPICIOUS.
phase4a_collage_2026_09_27.calibration: 22-image corpus: only poster.webp passes all gates (CV 0.22, c_min 342); closest real challenger fruit_strawberries misses both tile axes (CV 0.37, c_min 197); all other real photos CV 0.47-1.78, c_min <= 197. No real photo gains any boost.
phase4a_collage_2026_09_27.verification: poster.webp 47 INCONCLUSIVE -> 70 SUSPICIOUS HIGH as a standalone still; full regression suite 8/8 for the first time.
phase4a_collage_2026_09_27.still_open: Photorealistic AI stills without page context read 62 UNCERTAIN (honest abstain, no FPs); fix path is Phase 3b CLIP OOD.

retune_2026_09_27.change: Added muted-band (sat 0.30-0.50) flat-render signature with 4 banded signals (palette 350-1100, edge density 0.020-0.115, smooth8 0.30-0.55, texture floor p25 1.8-7.5; >=3 -> boost 60, 4/4 -> boost 70) + pf_strong structural floor in forensics/voter.py (boost>=70 lifts image verdicts to 70/SUSPICIOUS; guards: image-only, never over c2pa<=5 override).
retune_2026_09_27.calibration_corpus: 11 real photos (flowers/fruit/food/portrait/sunset/parrot/peppers) + 7 AI assets (3 web images + 4 IG reel key frames). Muted band: 0/10 in-band real photos fire; both muted AI targets fire at 70.
retune_2026_09_27.false_positive_check: Risky real photos (flower_macro, food_salad, portrait_bokeh, parrot, sunset) unchanged at 62 UNCERTAIN vs pre-change baseline (verified via git stash). The muted-band path itself fired on 0/10 real photos.
